note: LSI Corporation (formerly LSI Logic), semiconductors; Avago/Broadcom acquired it in 2014 for $6.6B. Menlo's position is a 1981 founding investment — the firm's oldest listed row and squarely pre-window, so entry_stage is null by policy.

Lytx is DriveCam renamed (2013); GTCR recapitalised it in 2016 and Permira bought a majority in 2020. Menlo's entry is the DriveCam growth round the Form D dates 2011-2012. Duplicate of 'drivecam-video-systems'.
Machine Zone (Game of War), mobile games; AppLovin acquired it in 2020. Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2012 (firm's own page).
MailFrontier, anti-phishing and anti-spam appliances; SonicWALL acquired it in 2006. First listed 2004, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.
Manifest OS, operating system for law firms; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2024 (firm's own page).
Matik, data-driven content personalization; Menlo partnered at the seed in 2019 (firm's own page), Form D 2019-2021 with Naomi Ionita on the filings; the follow-ons carry the graduation.
MealPal, lunch subscription; the business wound down after the pandemic destroyed office lunch demand. Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2017 (firm's own page and its own announcement post).

Media6Degrees, social-graph advertising targeting — renamed Dstillery in 2014 and still trading. Form D 2011 $19.9M with Mark Siegel. Recorded acquired-by-rename is wrong, so the row reads private under its successor name.
Mercor, AI-driven hiring and expert marketplace; Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2024 (firm's own page). The Wikidata pre-fill said LV, a namesake collision; Mercor is San Francisco.

MicroTherapeutics, neurovascular catheters and embolics; merged into ev3 in 2006 and on to Covidien/Medtronic. Recovered from the LOGO-ONLY row on the 1998 medical page (companies/MTILOGO.jpg) and corroborated by a Menlo fund 13G. A 1990s position, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.
Mimic, ransomware defence; Menlo partnered at the seed in 2024 (firm's own page).
Modal Labs, serverless GPU compute; Menlo partnered at the Series C in 2026 (firm's own page). Last primary $1.1B (2025 Series B) with a larger 2026 round reported.
MOG, music streaming; Beats Electronics acquired it in 2012 and Apple took it on in 2014. Form D 2009-2011 with Sonja Hoel Perkins.

Monarch Money, personal finance; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2021 (firm's own page). The 'defunct/EE' pre-fill is a namesake collision — Monarch is a live San Francisco company that raised a $75M Series B in 2025.
Mr. Number, caller ID and call blocking; Whitepages acquired it in 2013. Form D 2011 $4.8M — a Shervin Pishevar-attributed filing inside his 2011-2013 Menlo tenure, so the seat is Menlo's.

Munchery, on-demand meal delivery; shut down in January 2019. Form D 2014-2015 to $86.6M with Pravin Vazirani AND Shervin Pishevar — Vazirani's presence makes this a Menlo position rather than a Sherpa-era one.
NationGraph, AI sales intelligence for public-sector selling; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2025 (firm's own page).

nCircle Network Security, vulnerability and compliance management; Tripwire acquired it in 2013. First listed 2004, so the entry is pre-window and entry_stage is null — the band's 'Seed' rides a 2011 $1.0M filing seven years later.
Nectar Social, AI system of record for social marketing; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2026 (firm's own page).
NegotiateAI, a 2025 listing (founded 2024) with no description or milestone. Entry round not established.

Neon, serverless Postgres; Databricks acquired it in 2025 for ~$1B. Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2023 (firm's own page). The Wikidata pre-fill said GB; Neon is a US company with a distributed team.

Network Equipment Technologies (NET, NYSE then Nasdaq NWK); Sonus Networks acquired it in 2012. A 1983-85 Menlo position on the 1998 pages, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy. The public/CZ/$1.29B pre-fill is a namesake collision and is disputed.

Netlify, the web development platform. The site's Milestones say 'Partnered, Series C' with a 2024 close year, while press places Menlo in the 2021 Series D — the two disagree and neither is citable as the entry, so the row is recorded Growth (both readings are Series B or later) with the disagreement flagged. This is the row dropped from the calibration key for exactly this reason.
New Lantern, cloud and AI radiology; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2024 (firm's own page).
newScale, IT service catalog software; Cisco acquired it in 2011. First listed 2004, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy — the band's 'Seed' rides a 2009 $2.2M filing.

Nexxo Financial, self-service financial kiosks for the unbanked; wound down. Form D 2010-2013 with Douglas Carlisle. First listed 2005, so the band rides filings five years after the entry — low confidence.
Nourish, dietitian-led metabolic health; Menlo partnered at the Series C in 2026 (firm's own page).

Numeric, AI accounting automation; MENLO ENTERED AT THE $10M SEED of May 2024, not the $28M Series A it led that October — the firm's own Milestones say Seed 2024 and the press confirms the seed as its first investment.
oak9, infrastructure-as-code security; on the job board but not on the portfolio listing. Entry round not established.
Observable, data visualization and collaboration; Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2021 (firm's own page).
Observe.AI, conversation intelligence for contact centres; Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2020 (firm's own page and its own announcement post); the 2022 Series C post is the follow-on.
Obsidian Security, SaaS security posture; Menlo partnered at the Series C in 2022 (firm's own page).

Octel Communications, voicemail systems; Lucent Technologies acquired it in 1997 for $1.8B. A 1980s Menlo position on the 1998 communications page, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy. The public/FR pre-fill is a namesake collision (Octel Corp, the chemicals company) and is disputed.

OfferFit, reinforcement-learning lifecycle marketing; Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2023 (firm's own page and its own announcement post). Braze acquired it in 2025 — which is why Braze shares appear in Menlo's 2026 13F as consideration.

Open Solutions, core processing for community banks; NASDAQ IPO 2003, Carlyle and Providence took it private in 2007 and Fiserv acquired it in 2013. A 1990s Menlo position on the 1998 software page, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.
OpenEvidence, clinical AI copilot; Menlo partnered at the Series D in 2026 (firm's own page).
OpenHands (All Hands AI), open-source autonomous software engineering; Menlo partnered at the seed in 2024 (firm's own page).

OpenRouter, unified LLM API gateway; Stripe agreed to acquire it in 2026. Menlo partnered at the SEED in 2025 (firm's own page); the Form D band read Growth off the same year's $29.6M filing, which is the later round.
OpenSpace, 360-degree construction site documentation; Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2020 (firm's own page).
Ophelia, telemedicine for opioid use disorder; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2021 (firm's own page), Form D 2021 $50.0M with Greg Yap.
Opna Bio, clinical-stage oncology; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2021 (firm's own page). Swiss-headquartered with a South San Francisco site.
Orb, usage-based billing; Menlo partnered at the Series A (the site dates the close 2022, the announcement is March 2023 — the close-year rule of decisions.md R1). Adyen acquired it in 2026.
Orro, smart lighting and home control; on the job board but not on the portfolio listing. Entry round not established.
ParAccel, analytic database (the engine behind Amazon Redshift); Actian acquired it in 2013. Form D 2010-2011 with John Jarve on the filings.
Parade, capacity management for freight brokers; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2021 (firm's own page). Mudflap acquired it in 2026.
